liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Feel Like A Stranger** (2 reviews): Reviewer finds this version of Stranger particularly nice; Reviewer describes the Feel Like A Stranger as tight [20][25]
- **Althea** (2 reviews): Reviewer singles out Althea as a favorite; Reviewer says Althea feels like swimming in the ocean off a tropical island [22][25]
- **Ramble On Rose** (1 review): Reviewer recommends the audience recording mainly for its Ramble On Rose [15]
- **New Minglewood Blues** (1 review): Reviewer praises precisely placed notes in New Minglewood Blues, plus a strong organ solo [22]
- **Deal** (1 review): Deal seems headed for greatness but disappoints by skipping the second solo, according to the reviewer [20]

## The recordings

- **gd1980-06-07.144748.nak700.severson.miller.clugston.flac2496** (recommended): matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 26 songs; 170 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [1]
- **gd80-06-07.aud.sirmick.31348.sbeok.flacf**: audience recording; 25 songs; 154 min; rated 4.56/5 by 9 [4]. Said about its sound: Reviewer calls the Sirmick audience recording superb and top-notch, preferable to a soundboard; Reviewer calls the sound of this audience recording just okay [19][26]
- **gd1980-06-07.175816.aud.Langdon.Meyette.LuciferBurns.flac2448**: audience recording; 25 songs; 156 min [5]
- **gd1980-06-07.157131.aud.tompkins.flac2448**: audience recording; 25 songs; 153 min [6]
- **gd1980-06-07.SonyECM250.walker-scotton-miller.88451.sbeok.flac16**: source not stated; 25 songs; 160 min; rated 4.09/5 by 11 [9]. Said about its sound: Reviewer says the recording quality is not the best, though the musicianship stands out [22]
- **gd80-06-07.aud.munder.11533.sbeok.shnf**: audience recording; 24 songs; 146 min; rated 3.4/5 by 5 [12]. Said about its sound: Reviewer says this audience recording sounds like a rough bootleg, and that cleaner-sounding shows exist [16]

## Around the show

- Billed as the 15th anniversary show; on Boulder radio afterward, Weir said the milestone meant nothing to him [17]
- Attendee recalls dancing on the field over two days of Dead shows; Zevon repeated the same routine both Saturday and Sunday [23]
- The encore delivered three rock and roll songs in a row, which the reviewer enjoyed [25]
- A fan drove from NY to Boulder for the weekend [30]
- Reviewer finds the playing unusually tight and rates 1980 above 1977 for the band [26]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1980-06-07.144748.nak700.severson.miller.clugston.flac2496**: taped by Mark Severson; transferred by Scott Clugston and Charlie Miller; source: Mark Severson's Master Audience Cassettes; Nakamichi 700 mics (pole mounted at the soundboard)> Sony TC-D5 (Maxell UDXLII) [1]. Also: A 0:16 patch in Drums comes from the Sony ECM-250 source shnid 88451 [1]
- **gd80-06-07.aud.sirmick.31348.sbeok.flacf**: transferred by SIRMick; source: Audience: Unknown Mics [4]. Also: Disc 1 track 13 was patched from 1:47 to 2:00 using shnid 11533 to fix a stuttering effect; Disc 2 track 5 has a cut of just under a second at 4:14 [4]
- **gd1980-06-07.175816.aud.Langdon.Meyette.LuciferBurns.flac2448**: taped by Unknown Local Taper/Unknown Equipment; transferred by Wes Meyette; source: Analog Master > 1st Gen (Maxell UD) Langdon Master Series Vol. 28 [5]. Also: Comes from John Langdon's master and first-generation collection; he worked at Merlin's Workshop, an Albuquerque used-record store [5]
- **gd1980-06-07.157131.aud.tompkins.flac2448**: taped by Richie & Rip.; transferred by Transferred by Andrew F. 06/2022; source: Unknown mics & deck > Maxell XLII's (low-gen or possible master) [6]. Also: Lineage unknown, but it appears to be a master and matches no other current source; Several first-set tech snafus, including in Jack Straw, FOTD, El Paso and Far From Me, were patched from ID-142841; A Hicks/Fong alternate source covers a tape flip in Drums between 6:28 and 7:07 [6]
- **gd1980-06-07.SonyECM250.walker-scotton-miller.88451.sbeok.flac16**: taped by Recorded By Joani Walker right behind the soundboard; transferred by Charlie Miller; source: Sony ECM-250 -> Cassette Master (Sony TC-158/Maxell UDXLII-C90) [9]
- **gd80-06-07.aud.munder.11533.sbeok.shnf**: source: Audience Recording [12]
